howToUse: Use a b1_open_street_map panel to display an OpenStreetMap-backed map. Set `mapAddress` to a free-text address (geocoded via Nominatim on mount), or bind a DATA link to a DSO whose first row contains `lat`/`lng` (or `latitude`/`longitude`) fields. Override `tileServerUrl` to use a different OSM-compatible tile provider; adjust `zoomLevel` (0..19) for the initial zoom.
label: OpenStreetMap
objectTypeDescription: Map panel rendered with OpenStreetMap tiles via Leaflet. Sub-type of b1_map.
